title: Night Drive
description: Cruise down a glowing neon highway at night. Overtake slower cars, pass checkpoints to earn more time and keep the speedometer climbing.
instructions: Up / W to accelerate, Down / S to brake, Left and Right to steer.
On touch screens, use the on-screen pedals and steering.
Reach each checkpoint before the timer hits zero.
Hitting cars or leaving the road slows you down.
